# World map source

Community data from WOS Nerds: https://github.com/wosnerdwarriors/wos-data/tree/main/data/worldmap
Revision: 802a263238893581b1ae7fc38914fa660f37b42f
Dataset: data/worldmap/worldmap.json (198,365 populated cells; coordinates 0–1199).

Combined tile keys: 1 mountain, 2 lake, 3 building, 4 castle, 5 fortress/stronghold area, 6 facility area, 7 alliance resource node coverage.

Placement rules follow the WOS Nerds planner: keys 1,2,3,4,7 block city and structure placement. Key 5 allows cities; key 6 allows planned objects. Area colouring is not a building footprint. World features remain fixed; LUN template obstacles are separate editable planning objects.

This dataset is a community reference. It does not establish live state occupancy, current resource-node completeness, state-specific differences or universal game-map accuracy. Game names and underlying game content belong to their respective owners.
